summary: The final account rests on sync_log adding one for a StopSign on top of a prefix that already covers it, leaving the accepted index one past the readable log. That has been inferred from the run-13 end state and ordering, so this experiment isolates it directly. Node 5 accepts entries 1..2 and the StopSign through the real leader-plus-reconfigure flow, then is moved to Prepare under ballot 2 and handed a crafted AcceptSync whose log_sync has sync_idx 3, an empty suffix and the StopSign, a prefix that already covers the marker's position. The before_sync event records node 5 at accepted 3 with the StopSign at index 2, and after_sync records whether the accepted index rose beyond the three positions it can read. The declared comparison requires accepted to stay 3 for any admitted run, so a rise to 4 is a complete, violated comparison and a minimal witness of the inflation; an unchanged 3 would show the run-13 inflation came from a different path and would require correcting the account. The test is selected on its own, the randomized experiment is untouched, and no other records change.
